name: Wrapped nuc nac
summary: Gói quả núc nác is an Ede dish of wrapped núc nác fruit, one of the plates Ede families still cook in the province.
origin: Bao Lam Dong, Mỹ Hằng, 22 Sep 2023, in a feature on Dak Nong kitchens.
seoTitle: Goi qua nuc nac — Ede dish in Dak Nong
seoDescription: Bao Lam Dong names wrapped núc nác fruit as an Ede dish in Dak Nong.
